headline: Epic reportedly delays Disney shooter to pivot development to AI
summary: Epic Games reportedly delayed an unnamed Disney shooter, tied to the Marvel/Star Wars franchise, so it could pivot to an AI-first development model. Developers were reportedly ordered to use AI for both code and art, with no more hand-written code or AI-free art allowed on the project.
